n: Actua Voice Activated AI audio model activity
t: A classroom activity where students train a keyword listening model in Teachable Machine.
steps: Find the Actua page for Voice Activated AI: Training Audio Recognition Models.
Read the activity guide before class.
Check that each device has a working browser and microphone.
Allow microphone access in the browser when the page asks.
Choose a quiet room for recording.
Try the pre-trained audio classifier with the class.
Let students train and test their own keyword model in Teachable Machine.
End with a talk on whether the model suits the task.
